content:
After running multiple AI Experience Sessions with diverse teams, we uncovered a critical insight: operations leaders face unique challenges that demand focused attention. Manual processes, data bottlenecks, and cross-functional inefficiencies aren't just minor inconveniences—they're systematic profit killers that compound over time.

‍

The Hidden Cost of Manual Operations In today's B2B tech companies, operations teams are struggling with growing demands while managing limited resources. Every manual data pull, every delayed report, and every cross-functional bottleneck isn't just consuming time—it's preventing strategic work, delaying revenue recognition, and hindering growth.

That's why we're introducing the AI Ops Lab, a complimentary private session designed specifically for operations teams to uncover $100K in efficiency wins. This isn't about general AI exploration—it's about finding specific, actionable opportunities in your operations.

The Evolution: From AI Experience Session to AI Ops Lab 

Our free AI Experience Sessions brought together leaders from different companies to explore AI opportunities. These sessions revealed something crucial: while AI's potential is vast, operations teams needed more than general knowledge—they needed focused attention on their specific workflows and processes.

The AI Ops Lab continues this no-cost approach but with a fundamental difference: instead of group sessions, each Lab focuses on one company's operations. This allows us to:

  • Map your specific workflows and identify true bottlenecks
  • Calculate concrete efficiency gains for your processes
  • Design automation solutions tailored to your environment
  • Plan implementation within your existing systems
  • Address your unique cross-functional challenges

Inside the Free AI Ops Lab

The Lab isn't just another AI workshop—it's a structured approach to finding and capturing value in your operations. In just one hour, we'll help you:

Process Mapping (20 minutes):
  • Map your key operations workflows
  • Document pain points and bottlenecks
Value Analysis (15 minutes):
  • Identify efficiency opportunities in your workflows
  • Apply our value calculator to your processes
Solution Design (20 minutes):
  • Visualize your automated workflow
  • Show department-wide efficiency gains
Implementation Q&A (5 minutes):
  • How will this solution integrate into our existing operations?
  • What data do we need, and is it clean, accessible, and sufficient?
Each selected company receives a comprehensive toolkit:
  • Financial Impact Calculator. Excel template
  • Process Map Template. Miro board
  • Implementation Roadmap Template. Slides
  • Lab Recording.

Why This Matters Now

Operations leaders are under increasing pressure to do more with less. Manual processes that were once manageable are now creating critical bottlenecks as companies scale. The AI Ops Lab helps you:

  • Find automation opportunities that deliver immediate value
  • Scale operations without adding headcount
  • Transform data bottlenecks into automated workflows
  • Turn manual processes into competitive advantages

Who Should Apply? 

The complimentary AI Ops Lab is exclusively for operations leaders who:

  • Lead a team in a tech company with $50M to $500M in sales
  • Have significant manual processes impacting efficiency
  • Can implement automation initiatives
  • Sees oneself as a change agent

The Application Process

While the Lab remains free, we've introduced an application process to ensure we're working with teams ready to capture value from automation. This allows us to:

  • Focus on companies with the highest potential for impact
  • Ensure alignment with your specific challenges
  • Prepare customized materials for your session
  • Deliver maximum value in our time together

Our Promise

Walk away with a prioritized list of automation opportunities and a clear path to capture value. No cost, no risk, no obligations—just practical insights you can act on immediately.

Wrap Up

The AI Ops Lab represents our evolution in helping operations leaders turn manual processes into profit opportunities. While our AI Experience Sessions served their purpose, the time has come for focused, company-specific guidance on operations automation—still completely free for qualified teams.
